status_summary: FHWA published a final rule on 2025-04-18 (90 FR 16463), effective 2025-05-19, repealing the greenhouse gas measure that required states and metropolitan planning organizations to set declining carbon dioxide targets. A memorandum of 2025-03-07 from the FHWA Chief Counsel rescinded in full the 2021-12-16 memo urging use of infrastructure law funds on existing infrastructure and its 2023-02-24 update, and said FHWA was reviewing all of its infrastructure law guidance. An undated Eno Transportation Weekly article also reports that strategic priority sections were removed from program guidance reissued from April 2026. These steps cover the named items; the broader refocusing and reduction of federal involvement in local projects is not shown in the sources found.

timeline.event: The FHWA Chief Counsel issues a memorandum rescinding in full the 2021-12-16 Build a Better America policy memo on use of infrastructure law resources and its 2023-02-24 update, and states that FHWA is reviewing all of its infrastructure law guidance.
FHWA publishes a final rule (90 FR 16463, RIN 2125-AG16) repealing the greenhouse gas measure in 23 CFR part 490, including the declining carbon dioxide target and reporting requirement.
The greenhouse gas measure repeal took effect.
